required: Visible-light suppression plus transmission at illumination wavelengths
Nearby IR LED illumination with a controlled driver
Close-focus performance at the intended eye distance

baseline_proposal.filter: Factory-integrated NIR passband matched to LED emission
baseline_proposal.status: Proposed baseline; passband width and blocking requirements not yet quantified
baseline_proposal.broadband_note: Do not equate a narrow 940 nm passband with transmission across all 800-1000 nm. Retain broader range requirement for review if multi-wavelength operation is needed.

module_qualification.status: Not yet IR-qualified for this application
module_qualification.published: 940 nm lens coating claimed to suppress outdoor sunlight
not_established: Angular behavior over field of view

illumination.placement: Associated with each camera head; existing CAD LED blocks remain allowances
illumination.driver: Adjustable current limit, hardware default-off enable, provision for exposure synchronization
illumination.qualification: Determine output, distance, duty cycle, thermal load and eye exposure before operation; no eye-safety claim

procurement_priority: In-stock exact configured module or firm dated sample-build quote
Verified 10-20 mm NIR optics and supported USB firmware
Supplier existing circuit adapted to thin single board and four-wire USB
Do not rely on undated backorder or generic MIPI-to-USB compatibility

working_distance_mm.datum: front optical surface to target; confirm vendor datum
working_distance_mm.acceptance: usable pupil and glint detail throughout required interval; not just focus at one position

packaging.camera_head: miniature assembled optics/sensor, short flex, low-profile snap connector preferred
packaging.usb_board: one physical board; no stacked evaluation boards in wearable assembly
packaging.thickness_status: engineering targets; exact layer count, impedance, assembly and stiffeners require fabricator approval
packaging.host_interface: USB 2.0 High Speed via four-contact JST: 5V, D-, D+, GND; connector pinout to be verified
packaging.mass_status: minimize and report assembled mass; no invented mass limit
packaging.flex_length: shortest compatible with mounting geometry; no long evaluation tail as default
